identity.cache_policy: ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR and ZIG_LOCAL_CACHE_DIR per attempt inside the working copy

notice: Replay calibration only: it charges the M2 envelope over per-call usage measured from the M1b sessions, which ran with NO token budget and were never told one. It calibrates the envelope's arithmetic and how binding each cap is on those observed trajectories; it is not evidence about how an agent behaves when told a budget, which would require real sessions this does not run.
replays_test_split_only: The 14 measured cases are the test split of the M1b cohort. The four dev cases have no participant sessions, so no dev trajectory is replayed and none is claimed.

all.description: every measured M1b session for the case (all four presentation arms, both repetitions), repetition first and the M2-matching `text` arm first inside a repetition

text.description: the M1b `text` arm only — the M2 treatment match: the checker's plain-text output with no suggestion — in repetition order
